title: Porch-light answer variants
intent: Find words real people can answer together without making the room feel scripted.
voice_note: Plainspoken first-person plural; leave room for breath, overlap, and a singer's phrasing.
preserve: An ending that can remain open after the last sung vowel
avoid: Copying words, imagery, rhyme, meter, or narrative from references
Silently choosing a final version before it is sung in context

sources.note: Keep the important images and variants; do not assume these are approved final words.
sources.rights_note: Original private project writing; public wording and sharing are not approved.

variants.text: Replace with an original lyric variant.
variants.intent: Describe the emotional and conversational job of this version.
variants.singability_note: State what must be heard with real breath, pitch, timing, and group overlap before revising.
unresolved: Name one meaning, word, vowel, stress, range, or phrasing question that remains open.

variants.text: Replace with a genuinely different original alternative.
variants.intent: Preserve why this alternative deserves to remain available.
variants.singability_note: Do not call a line singable from text alone; identify what a performer should try.
unresolved: Name what this alternative reveals that the first one does not.
